tagline: 美能达取景器相机，1964 年发布
description: 美能达于1964年推出的取景器相机。配备Rokkor 1:2.8/38mm。快门速度speeds 1/30 (with max. aperture) up to 1/250 sec. (at f-stop 22), flash synchronized speed 1/30 sec. with apertures f2.8 to f16。使用35mm with speeds 25 to 800 ASA。

specs.快门: speeds 1/30 (with max. aperture) up to 1/250 sec. (at f-stop 22), flash synchronized speed 1/30 sec. with apertures f2.8 to f16
specs.曝光测光: match-needle meter cross-coupled to combined shutter-speed/aperture setting, instrument visible from above
specs.英文简介: The Minoltina-P was a quite compact 35mm viewfinder camera with coupled selenium meter.
